bounded_conclusions: Fresh prepared-solve success is not by itself evidence that prepare_solve clears a hidden linear-solver history defect.
For the same affine equation, strict rclose=1e-15 converges when started far from the root but can fail when the current head is already about 6e-14 m from that root.

The near-root state remains well inside the pre-registered 1e-10 m physical head gate, while its affine residual is too large for the stricter residual certificate and too small to produce a useful floating-point head correction.

DSW-09 exposes two distinct numerical effects: MODERATE nonlinear under-relaxation history changes the reanchor trajectory, and near-root strict convergence can withhold the subsystem certificate after the external physical residual is already closed.
forbidden_inference: Do not infer a production residual tolerance from this one-cell diagnostic.
Do not weaken the original DSW-09 preregistered gate post hoc.
